description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340016805882 BRACKET,MOUNTING: Line 0001 Qty 99 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0102 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
